gen-gf-neucha-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generously open and feels thoroughly modern, a tidy sans-serif foil to the hand-drawn heading. Amulya would wear a little thin over a long page, though, while Neucha's broad-nib warmth stays charming up top.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-bespoke-sans: Pen-drawn charm meets crisp precision here. Neucha's tubelike, constant-weight lines lean friendly and handmade, and Bespoke Sans tidies things up below with sharp sans letters that leave plenty of room at the curve ends.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-literata: Bookish and a little sophisticated, Literata sets the tone below, its hairlines present but sturdy. And where Neucha is best at a handwritten, tight-knit greeting, Literata is best at carrying a text serif's quiet weight.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-plein: Reliable, in a clean-lined way. Neucha's arms and legs keep a constant width and a hand-drawn friendliness, while Plein sends a clear channel into each round letter, so the sans below feels made for easy reading.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-recia: A loose, spaghetti-line scrawl meets a sharp-edged serif. And Recia's thick-thin ratio is measured and authoritative, so beside Neucha's wandering friendliness it feels like a firm handshake after a wave.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-rowan: Neucha looks like a sign-painter's brush pulled at constant width, tight and friendly. But Rowan's thin strokes run only slightly lighter than its thick ones, giving the serif a literary warmth that settles in beside the heading.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-spline-sans: Broad-nib curves left open and unfinished give Neucha its hand-drawn charm. Spline Sans follows with identical vertical and horizontal strokes and wide gaps at the curve ends, a contemporary sans that keeps the handmade heading grounded.
gen-gf-neucha-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve and a dependable feel. Neucha's tight, hand-drawn heading gives it personality.
gen-gf-neucha-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves stopping well before they close, like cable bent into shapes. Neucha handles the handwritten warmth; Outfit handles the plain sans-serif work.
gen-gf-neucha-plus-jakarta-sans: Friendly, with a hand-drawn grace up top. Neucha's broad-nib curves stay loose and unfinished, while Plus Jakarta Sans adds a monoline, precise sans-serif beneath, its curve endings kept well apart.
